{{Vanilla|Biome}}
'''Biomes''' generate in the same places as in vanilla ''Minecraft'', but [[Matcha Flavoured]] overrides 65 of them to change their mob spawns, ore and plant features, and colors. The pack's resource pack also replaces the grass and foliage color maps with its own gradated maps (made by Movpasd), which changes the color of plants in every biome.

== General changes ==
; Husks everywhere
: Almost every overworld biome gains [[Husk]]s as a monster spawn (weight 75, groups of 1–2), and the [[Zombie]] weight is raised to 100. In deserts the husk weight is lowered from 80 to 75 and the zombie weight raised from 19 to 100. Husks act as slow, strong "tanks" next to fast zombies; see [[Husk]].<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.10|quote=Husks now spawn in all biomes}}</ref>
; Silver
: [[Native Silver]] replaces {{MCW|Emerald Ore|emerald ore}}. Nearly every overworld biome gains a deep silver feature: 3 veins per chunk, or 5 in mountain biomes, in a triangular distribution from 80 blocks below to 80 blocks above the bottom of the world (so most silver is found near Y=-64 and none above Y=16).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/worldgen/placed_feature/ore_emerald_deep.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/worldgen/placed_feature/ore_emerald_deep_mountain.json}}</ref> The vanilla mountain emerald feature is kept, but with 50 attempts per chunk instead of 100.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/worldgen/placed_feature/ore_emerald.json}}</ref> The Deep Dark gets both the mountain deep feature and the vanilla feature.
; Quartz
: [[Quartz Deposit]]s replace {{MCW|Lapis Lazuli Ore|lapis lazuli ore}}. Their main feature places 12 veins per chunk between Y=-32 and Y=96 (vanilla: 2 veins between Y=-32 and Y=32), so quartz is common at higher elevations and useful for glass.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/worldgen/placed_feature/ore_lapis.json}}</ref>
; Frozen biomes
: Snowy and frozen biomes have pale sky and fog colors and drifting white ash particles. Stony Peaks is the only overworld biome override that does not gain a deep silver feature. Swimming in their water causes [[Freezing water|freezing]].
; Pale Garden
: The Pale Garden has no hostile mob spawns.
; Hell
: Gravel no longer generates in [[Hell]], and [[Hellspore]] (Nether wart) grows naturally on the surface of Nether Wastes and Soul Sand Valleys. See [[Hell#Generation]].

| <code>matcha:ore_emerald_deep_mountain</code> || Cherry Grove, Deep Dark, Frozen Peaks, Grove, Jagged Peaks, Meadow, Snowy Slopes, Windswept Forest, Windswept Gravelly Hills, Windswept Hills || As above with 5 per chunk.

== Music ==
The resource pack replaces the forest background music with the track "Abbey", so it plays in Forest, Birch Forest, Old Growth Birch Forest and Dark Forest. See [[Music]].

== History ==
{{History
|{{History line|0.5-alpha|Freshwater and saltwater biomes grouped into five fishing climates each (see [[Fishing]]).}}
{{History line|0.6-alpha|Sand, red sand and packed mud support vegetation.}}
{{History line|1.0|Deserts no longer have flowers; desert and badlands sky and fog colors changed.}}
{{History line|1.10|Husks spawn in all biomes.
* Creepers no longer spawn in forests, only underground.
* The Pale Garden no longer spawns hostile mobs.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Silver is less common on the surface, found rarely in every biome and more often deep in mountain biomes.
* Large coal veins at deepslate level beneath deserts.
* Quartz generates at higher elevations and in larger amounts.
* Blue orchids and cornflowers on beaches.
* Hellspore generates in Soul Sand Valleys and Nether Wastes; gravel removed from Hell.
* Cats spawn in Jungles and Sparse Jungles.
* Purple placeholder grass colors replaced by gradated color maps.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|Taiga grass color changed.}}
}}
